description: This file defines the Route53ProfilesClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods for interacting with the Route 53 Profiles service, including managing profiles and resource associations.

classes.name: Route53ProfilesClient
classes.description: A client class for the Route 53 Profiles AWS service, providing methods to manage profiles and resource associations.

methods.name: associateProfile
methods.description: Associates a profile with a resource.

methods.name: associateProfileAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a profile with a resource.

methods.name: disassociateProfile
methods.description: Disassociates a profile from a resource.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific profile.

methods.name: updateProfileResourceAssociation
methods.description: Updates the association between a profile and a resource.
